title: BioIVT: the two stage questions say what they hold
description: Relabels Oncology 'UICC Stage' to 'TNM classification (for example T2N0M0)' and 'Stage' to 'Stage group'. The two questions hold different things, so both stay.
rationale: Real data: 'UICC Stage' holds TNM strings (T3N0M0, T2N0M0), 'Stage' holds stage groups (II, IIA, IIB). The old labels did not say so.
source: BioIVT Option C update; approved by Dan

history.note: Stage group and therapy outcome update.
